description: List customers, optionally filtered by code or name prefix, currency or modification date. Unleashed: GET /Customers/{page}.

currency.description: Only customers with exactly this currency code, e.g. NZD.

customerCode.description: Only customers whose code starts with this.

customerName.description: Only customers whose name starts with this.

modifiedSince.description: Only records created or modified since this UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD).

pageSize.description: Records per page, 1-1000. Unleashed default is 200.

name: unleashed_list_customers
title: List customers
